color.description: The color to use for the animated effect.

haloRadius.description: The radius of a halo at the end of its animation.

haloWidth.description: The width of a halo at the end of its animation.

linkWidth.description: The width of a link at the end of its animation.

repeat.description: The number of times the animation should be repeated.

time.description: The time the animation should take, in milliseconds.

title:
The type defining configuration for a temporarily animated halo effect to a node or a link, also known as a ping
effect.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationPingConfig
